run_preprocess_index_data: run the preprocess script to index text data into a binary .pth file using a vocabulary
run_dictionary_read_vocab: run Dictionary.read_vocab to load a vocabulary file with words and counts into a dictionary object
run_dictionary_index_data: run Dictionary.index_data to index raw text into a binary file using an existing dictionary
review_preprocess_pipeline: review the preprocess pipeline that reads vocab, indexes text, and logs unknown word statistics
summarize_preprocess_output: summarize the preprocess output showing total words, unique words, sentences, and unknown word coverage
